content.name: Deft Explorer
entries: Thanks to your travels, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Expertise
entries: Choose one of your skill proficiencies with which you lack {@variantrule Expertise|SRD52}. You gain {@variantrule Expertise|SRD52} in that skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You know two languages of your choice from the language tables in {@book chapter 2|SRD52|2|Choose Languages}.
